title: Major cloud provider confirms breach affecting millions of accounts
body: The company says attackers accessed customer emails and hashed passwords for roughly 40 million accounts over a two-week window before detection. Password resets are being forced for all affected users.

title: PSA: reset your password now, the breach is worse than first reported
body: Security researchers are now saying billing information may have been exposed too, not just emails and password hashes as originally stated. Enable 2FA if you haven't already.

title: Lawsuit filed within hours of data breach disclosure
body: A proposed class action was filed this afternoon alleging the company knew about the vulnerability for months before it was exploited.

title: Researchers announce promising results for universal flu vaccine in phase 2 trial
body: The trial showed strong antibody response across multiple flu strains, including ones not specifically targeted by the vaccine formulation. Phase 3 trials are expected to begin next year.

title: Scientists cautiously optimistic after universal flu vaccine trial results
body: While experts stress that phase 2 results don't guarantee eventual approval, the antibody breadth seen in this trial is described as unusually encouraging by outside researchers.

title: What the new flu vaccine trial results actually mean, explained
body: A breakdown of the phase 2 data, what phase 3 will need to show, and a realistic timeline for when a universal flu vaccine could actually reach pharmacies.

title: Airline cancels 400 flights with no warning, passengers stranded overnight
body: The airline blames a scheduling system failure but has not explained why affected passengers weren't notified until they arrived at the gate. No compensation has been offered yet.

title: Stranded passengers describe chaos after mass flight cancellations
body: Several travelers said they slept on airport floors after being told hotel vouchers were unavailable due to the scale of the cancellations.

title: Tech company announces 12% workforce reduction, effective immediately
body: Affected employees were notified by email this morning and lost access to internal systems within the hour. The company cited 'a more sustainable cost structure' in its announcement.

title: Rover captures clearest images yet of ancient riverbed on Mars
body: Geologists say the sediment layering strongly suggests sustained water flow over a long period, adding to evidence the region may have once been habitable.

title: Widespread phishing campaign impersonating tax authority targets thousands
body: The emails closely mimic official formatting and ask recipients to 'verify' banking details through a fake portal. Several banks have issued warnings this week.

title: All 12 miners rescued after three days trapped following tunnel collapse
body: Rescue crews worked in shifts around the clock, drilling a secondary shaft after the primary access route proved too unstable. All miners are reported in stable condition.

title: Automaker recalls 90,000 vehicles over faulty brake sensor
body: The company says the sensor can falsely report normal brake function even when pad wear has reached unsafe levels. Owners are urged to schedule inspection immediately.

title: Startup raises $40M to build AI tools for rare disease diagnosis
body: The company says its model flags patterns in imaging data that radiologists commonly miss on first pass, though it stresses the tool is meant to assist, not replace, diagnosis.

title: Dockworkers announce indefinite strike over automation dispute
body: The union says ongoing negotiations over job protections related to new automated cargo systems broke down without resolution. Ports across three states are affected.

title: Record turnout reported as polls close in closely watched election
body: Officials say early estimates put turnout well above the historical average for this type of election, though final certified numbers won't be available for several days.

title: Executive sentenced to 8 years for investment fraud scheme
body: Prosecutors said the scheme defrauded over 600 investors of a combined $80 million over six years, using falsified account statements to conceal losses.

title: Region declares emergency as heatwave pushes temperatures past all-time record
body: Officials opened emergency cooling centers and warned residents, particularly the elderly, to avoid outdoor activity during peak afternoon hours for the next several days.

title: Shelter reports record number of pet adoptions this month
body: Staff say a mix of a local awareness campaign and reduced adoption fees drove the surge, clearing out nearly the entire dog kennel for the first time in years.

title: New battery chemistry claims 500-mile EV range on a 10-minute charge
body: Independent testing hasn't yet confirmed the manufacturer's claims, and researchers caution that lab conditions often don't translate directly to real-world driving.

title: Teacher of the year credits small class sizes for turnaround in reading scores
body: Her school piloted a program capping classes at 15 students two years ago; reading proficiency in that cohort has since risen from 40% to 78%.

title: Widespread internet outage disrupts service across three continents
body: The outage traced back to a misconfigured routing update at a major backbone provider, affecting an estimated 15% of global traffic for roughly 90 minutes.

title: Conservationists report first wild sighting of species thought extinct for 30 years
body: The sighting was confirmed via camera trap footage in a remote reserve, sparking a rapid expansion of protected habitat boundaries in the surrounding area.

title: Grocery prices rise for ninth straight month, outpacing wage growth
body: Economists point to a combination of supply chain costs and consolidation among distributors, though the exact split of causes remains disputed.

title: Chipmaker unveils processor promising 40% efficiency gain over previous generation
body: Early benchmarks from the company's own labs show substantial gains in performance-per-watt, though third-party testing won't be available until devices ship next quarter.

title: Thousands evacuated as river breaches levee after days of heavy rain
body: Emergency crews are using boats to reach residents in low-lying neighborhoods that flooded within hours of the levee failure overnight.

title: Anonymous donor pays off medical debt for entire county
body: The donation, arranged through a nonprofit that buys distressed medical debt at a discount, cleared roughly $9 million owed by around 4,000 residents.

title: App quietly changed privacy policy to allow selling location data to advertisers
body: The change was buried in a routine-looking update notice; users who don't opt out within 30 days will be automatically enrolled in the new data-sharing terms.

title: Construction begins on long-delayed bridge project after 15 years of planning
body: Local officials say the bridge, once complete, will cut commute times for an estimated 30,000 daily drivers by avoiding a 20-minute detour around the river.

title: Hobbyist finds critical vulnerability in smart lock used by millions of homes
body: The flaw allows an attacker within Bluetooth range to unlock the device without credentials. The manufacturer says a patch is in testing but has no firm release date.

title: Reservoir falls to lowest level on record amid multi-year drought
body: Water authorities announced the first mandatory usage restrictions in over a decade, affecting both agricultural and residential water allocations starting next month.

title: Local nurse honored nationally for developing low-cost neonatal warming device
body: The device, built from commonly available materials, has reportedly reduced hypothermia-related complications by half in the rural clinic where it was first deployed.

title: Regulators block proposed merger over antitrust concerns
body: The agency's filing argues the combined company would control an estimated 65% of the relevant market, well above thresholds that typically trigger a block.

title: Company successfully deploys constellation providing internet to remote regions
body: Early users in previously unconnected areas report speeds sufficient for video calls for the first time, though the company acknowledges capacity limits during peak hours.

title: Central bank holds interest rates steady, signals possible cut next quarter
body: The decision matched analyst expectations, though the accompanying statement was read by markets as more dovish than the bank's previous guidance.
